items.t: Trump cancels rallies in Kansas and Iowa, opting for telerallies
items.x: His party said the telerallies could reach more voters in nearly two dozen states in the final days of a midterm election that could cost the GOP control of Congress.

items.t: Trial date set for man charged with attacking White House correspondents’ dinner
items.x: Cole Tomas Allen’s trial is scheduled to start with jury selection on Sept. 7 and is expected to last approximately three to four weeks.

items.t: 3 dead in Oregon helicopter collision, including flight instructor and student pilot
items.x: Photos show the aftermath of a deadly helicopter collision in near an Oregon airport.

items.t: Dyslexia expert offers steps to improve reading fluency
items.x: Bonnie Terry says short, consistent reading drills can help struggling readers make significant progress.

items.t: Still need an idea for carving your pumpkin? NPS has free national park-inspired stencils
items.x: Still need a pumpkin idea? The National Park Service has free jack-o'-lantern stencils inspired by America's parks and wildlife, including a "Fat Bear" and a bison with a warning.

items.t: Showers possible for Trick-or-Treaters on the Gulf Coast
items.x: Breezy conditions with scattered showers are possible through the weekend

items.t: Florida financial aid breach exposes Social Security numbers of nearly 5 million
items.x: The FLDOE announced that its financial aid website was hacked, impacting almost five million Floridians.

items.t: US Senate candidate Mary Peltola denies role as DOJ issues subpoenas in Alaska election probe
items.x: Democrat Mary Peltola of Alaska says, "I knew nothing," after allegations that her campaign was involved in recruiting another candidate with the same name as Republican Dan Sullivan.

items.t: Second arrest made after dog Sparkle dies in wired-shut cage in Golden Gate
items.x: The Collier County Sheriff's Office announced on Thursday that a second arrest has been made in connection with the death of Sparkle, a dog that was found dead after being trapped in a wired-shut gate outside in Golden Gate.

items.t: Potbellied pig with no tags impounded in DeSoto County as deputies seek owner
items.x: A black and white potbellied pig was impounded at the DeSoto County Sheriff's Office Impound on Wednesday.

items.t: 3 people killed after 2 helicopters collide in Oregon
items.x: Three people were killed when two helicopters collided near McMinnville Airport in Oregon

items.t: Midterm candidates say they are winning voters across party lines
items.x: Some midterm election candidates have recently been promoting their ability to win over voters from across party lines but experts say it may not be enough to change outcomes in November.

items.t: Roof of a water tower in NYC where a rare family of barn owls nested has been removed
items.x: The first documented barn owl nest in modern Manhattan was exposed when a water tower roof was removed, sparking criticism and concern.

items.t: Youth sports coach sentenced for sexually assaulting 12-year-old girl he coached
items.x: A youth sports coach has been sentenced to 26 years in prison for sexually assaulting a 12-year-old girl he coached.

items.t: Coach June Jones dies at 73
items.x: June Jones, the trailblazing coach who led the University of Hawaii to its greatest era, has died at 73. He also spent time coaching in the NFL and was a former Atlanta Falcons quarterback.

items.t: Niño disfrazado de la Parca alarma a vecinos de San Carlos Park
items.x: Niño disfrazado de la Parca asusta a vecinos en San Carlos Park, Florida; sheriff confirma que era una broma sin intención criminal.

items.t: Humid and rainy conditions return to the Suncoast
items.x: Increased rain chances for this weekend.

items.t: North Korea's Kim calls for rapid expansion of drone technology and observes weapons tests
items.x: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for rapidly expanding the country's drone technology and observed tests of various weapons, state media reported Friday.

items.t: Halloween falls on a Saturday this year, and the next one is more than a decade away
items.x: We'll need to wait a while before Halloween falls on a Saturday again after this year.

items.t: Hugh Jackman, William Shatner and George Takei among those paying tribute to Patrick Stewart
items.x: Following the death of Patrick Stewart at 86, a slew of tributes from acting colleagues and even Marvel Studios poured in on Thursday.
